argument_summary: The supportable position is narrower than clean certification: the admissible record supports certification only if the audit packet treats the Spanish-language billing-support weakness as an unresolved material limitation, discloses it in the model card, and does not claim the draft runbook resolves it. On that reading, the packet is directionally consistent with the readiness evidence showing aggregate launch readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, alongside public guidance favoring deployment with ongoing measurement, monitoring, and documented limitations.
claims_about_business_cost: Escalating this as if the actor claimed caveat-free compliance would overstate the mismatch and create avoidable launch friction. The narrower certification position preserves launch velocity while keeping the unresolved Spanish billing issue visible for monitoring and governance. The material business risk is not the disclosed limitation itself; it is mischaracterizing the limitation as resolved when the record does not support that claim.
claims_about_policy: The governing policy does not support caveat-free certification on this record. The admissible evidence says the Spanish billing-ticket triage slice remains below target, and the draft mitigation lacks the required approval elements: owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion as an approved mitigation package. The policy therefore permits a defensible certification case only as disclosure-dependent, caveated compliance: disclose the named limitation for the launch use case unless and until it is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
concessions: The current record does not support any claim that no material limitation exists.
The draft runbook and future monitoring do not remove the current disclosure requirement.
The quantitative readiness and rehearsal claims are not independently verifiable from the summary alone by this role.
A stronger clean-certification case would require the underlying artifacts and, if relying on mitigation, an approved mitigation record with the required fields.
